title: Westpac Credit Card Changes Effective 30 September 2026
body:
https://www.westpac.com.au/personal-banking/credit-cards/cre…
TLDR:
Program Fee for
Altitude Rewards: $0->$75
Qantas or Velocity Rewards: $75 -> $155
NOTE: You still need to pay annual fee separately, and the new fee amount will apply on your next card fee date.
Altitude Rewards Points Transfer Rate change:
Virgin Australia, Singapore Krisflyer, Cathay Asia Miles: 3:1 -> 4:1
AirNZ Koru Points: 180:1 -> 300:1
Qantas/Velocity Black Earn Rate:
All other purchases (including Dining): $1: 0.5 points -> $1: 0.4 points up to 10K spend
Travel Insurance Changes:
Pretty much stripped to bare minimum with loads of exclusions. (Medical Insurance only overseas, domestic travel insurance and car hire excess in Australia)
